articles.summary: Hospital rapid response teams (RRTs) provide on-the-fly critical care in respiratory, cardiac, neurologic, and other clinical emergencies. Since RRTs are generally not the primary service, they are often dependent on the willingness of front line providers and nurses to be activated. As such, RRT members are part craftsman, delivering expert care, and part salesperson, encouraging the hospital to use their services. We therefore propose the following Ten Commandments for Hospital Rapid Response Teams to engender strong collaboration and RRT program success.
articles.title: The Ten Commandments for Hospital Rapid Response Teams
